# Re://:Swarm Wiki
> The community wiki for Re://:Swarm (Re Swarm, ReSwarm), a reimagined take on classic Bee Swarm Simulator on Roblox. Bees, items, fields, quests, codes and update logs.

Re://:Swarm (also written Re Swarm, ReSwarm or Reswarm) is a Roblox game made by ReplicatedEvents and released on August 26, 2026. It is a reimagined version of an older Bee Swarm Simulator, rebuilt with new assets. This wiki (Re://:Swarm Wiki, Reswarm Wiki) documents its bees, items, beequips, fields, mobs, quests, codes and update logs.

## Home
- [Home](https://reswarm.org/)

## Hive Builder
- [Hive Builder](https://reswarm.org/hive-builder.html): Plan your Re://:Swarm hive: pick bees by rarity, set your hive slots, mark gifted bees, then share the link or save it as a picture.

## Fields
- [Fields](https://reswarm.org/browse-fields.html): Fields sorted by the bee zone they are in.
- [Ant Field](https://reswarm.org/ant-field.html): The Ant Field is a field located past the Ant Gate and near the Top Ant Exterminators leaderboard. It can only be accessed by starting the Ant Challenge which will summon waves of ants.
- [Bamboo Field](https://reswarm.org/bamboo-field.html): The Bamboo Field is a field located past the Basic Bee Gate, to the right of the Spider Field, and 2 fields away from the Strawberry Field. It is protected by two Rhino Beetles, one being level 2...
- [Blue Flower Field](https://reswarm.org/blue-flower-field.html): The Blue Flower Field is one of the five starting fields any player can visit upon starting the game. It is the first blue field accessible in the game. It is protected by a level 1 rhino beetle.
- [Cactus Field](https://reswarm.org/cactus-field.html): The Cactus Field is a field located past the Honey Bee Gate and lies right beside the Pumpkin Patch. It is protected by the Werewolf.
- [Clover Field](https://reswarm.org/clover-field.html): The Clover Field is one of the five starting fields any player is able to visit upon starting the game. It is protected by a Ladybug and a Rhino Beetle.
- [Coconut Field](https://reswarm.org/coconut-field.html): The Coconut Field is a field added in the September 28, 2019 update, located past the Windy Bee Gate and next to Spirit Bear. It is home to and protected by the Coconut Crab.
- [Dandelion Field](https://reswarm.org/dandelion-field.html): The Dandelion Field is one of the five starting fields any player is able to visit upon starting the game. There are no mobs that protect this field.
- [Field Boost](https://reswarm.org/field-boost.html): A Field Boost is a stacking buff that provides a bonus to pollen gained, from all sources, from a specific field. Each stack of a field boost increases pollen gained from its field by 100% and has...
- [Field Wind](https://reswarm.org/field-wind.html): A Field Wind is a stacking buff that grants a bonus to pollen and instant conversion to a specific field. Each stack of a field wind increases pollen gained from its field by a set amount...
- [Fields](https://reswarm.org/fields.html): Fields, also referred to as "patches" or "forests" are square/rectangular areas of flowers scattered around the map, where players are able to collect pollen, which can be converted into honey at...
- [Flowers](https://reswarm.org/flowers.html): Flowers can be found in all fields. They can be interacted with using different sources to obtain pollen from and later be converted into honey. There are 5 flower sizes: single, double, triple,...
- [Hub Field](https://reswarm.org/hub-field.html): The Hub Field is a field that was added in the 2024-01-12 update and is located in the trading portal beyond the Ant Gate inside the Hive Hub.
- [Mountain Top Field](https://reswarm.org/mountain-top-field.html): The Mountain Top Field is a field located past the Lion Bee Gate. The Mondo Chick protects this field and respawns roughly every hour.
- [Mushroom Field](https://reswarm.org/mushroom-field.html): The Mushroom Field is one of the five starting fields any player is able to visit upon starting the game. It is the first red field accessible to players in the game. The field is protected by a...
- [Pepper Patch](https://reswarm.org/pepper-patch.html): The Pepper Patch is a field that was added in the September 28, 2019 update, located past the Windy Bee Gate, to the right of the Extreme Memory Match and to the left of the Wind Shrine. There are...
- [Pine Tree Forest](https://reswarm.org/pine-tree-forest.html): The Pine Tree Forest is a field located past the Honey Bee Gate and near the Badge Bearer's Guild. It is protected by two mantises and the Werewolf.
- [Pineapple Patch](https://reswarm.org/pineapple-patch.html): The Pineapple Patch is a field located past the Brave Bee Gate and to the right of the Pro Shop. It is protected by a level 4 mantis and a level 5 rhino beetle.
- [Pumpkin Patch](https://reswarm.org/pumpkin-patch.html): The Pumpkin Patch is a field located past the Honey Bee Gate and it lies right beside the Cactus Field. It is protected by the werewolf.
- [Rose Field](https://reswarm.org/rose-field.html): The Rose Field is one of the four fields located past the Honey Bee Gate. This field can be found near the Red HQ. It is protected by two scorpions, one level 5, and the other level 6.
- [Spider Field](https://reswarm.org/spider-field.html): The Spider Field is a field located past the Basic Bee Gate and lies between the Strawberry Field and Bamboo Field. The field is protected by the spider.
- [Strawberry Field](https://reswarm.org/strawberry-field.html): The Strawberry Field is a field located past the Basic Bee Gate, to the left of the Spider Field, and beside the Vicious Bee Claimer. This field is protected by 2 ladybugs; one of which is level 2...
- [Stump Field](https://reswarm.org/stump-field.html): The Stump Field is a field that was added in the 2018-11-25 update and is located past the Brave Bee Gate next to the Pineapple Patch.
- [Sunflower Field](https://reswarm.org/sunflower-field.html): The Sunflower Field is one of the five starting fields that any player can visit upon starting the game. There are no mobs that protect this field.

## Mobs
- [Mobs](https://reswarm.org/browse-mobs.html): Field mobs are sorted by bee zone, like the Fields page. Bosses, challenge mobs, event mobs and Puffshrooms come after.
- [Ladybug](https://reswarm.org/ladybug.html): The ladybug is a mob that defends three different fields.
- [Rhino Beetle](https://reswarm.org/rhino-beetle.html): The Rhino Beetle is a mob that defends four different fields. It is the blue variant of the Ladybug.
- [Spider](https://reswarm.org/spider.html): The Spider is a level 4 mob that can only be found in the Spider Field.
- [Mantis](https://reswarm.org/mantis.html): The Mantis is a mob that defends the Pineapple Patch and the Pine Tree Forest.
- [Scorpion](https://reswarm.org/scorpion.html): The Scorpion is a mob that spawns in the Rose Field.
- [Werewolf](https://reswarm.org/werewolf.html): The Werewolf is a level 7 mob found only behind the Honey Bee Gate. Unlike other mobs, it defends three fields instead of one: the Cactus Field, Pine Tree Forest, and the Pumpkin Patch. It spawns...
- [King Beetle](https://reswarm.org/king-beetle.html): The King Beetle is a level 7 boss mob that resides in his lair. The entrance to his lair is on the wall between the Blue Flower Field and the Clover Field, above the blue flower closest to the...
- [Stump Snail](https://reswarm.org/stump-snail.html): The Stump Snail is a level 6 mob that occupies the Stump Field. With 30,000,000 health, it idly moves along the circumference of the field, posing no direct threat but dealing 30 damage upon contact.
- [Tunnel Bear](https://reswarm.org/tunnel-bear.html): Tunnel Bear is a hostile level 9 boss mob.
- [Cave Monster](https://reswarm.org/cave-monster.html): The Cave Monster is a level 11 mob that spawns inside the Werewolf's Cave. They look identical to a spider, except that they lack eyes. Cave Monsters make eerie whispering noises when the player...
- [Commando Chick](https://reswarm.org/commando-chick.html): This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.
- [Mondo Chick](https://reswarm.org/mondo-chick.html): The Mondo Chick is a level 8 boss chick located in the Mountain Top Field. It respawns every hour at the full hour (1:00, 2:00, 3:00, etc., not in time zones that are a fractional number of hours...
- [Coconut Crab](https://reswarm.org/coconut-crab.html): The Coconut Crab is a level 12 boss mob that defends the Coconut Field. It has 250,000 health and moves along the back wall of the Coconut Field. Like Tunnel Bear, chicks (besides the Commando...
- [Ants](https://reswarm.org/ants.html): Ants are mobs exclusively found in the Ant Field during the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate. In the Ant Challenge, the player fights waves of ants before the timer runs out. The level and health...
- [Ant](https://reswarm.org/ant.html): An Ant is one of five mobs that is part of a family called Ants that are exclusively found in the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate.
- [Fire Ant](https://reswarm.org/fire-ant.html): A Fire Ant is one of five ants that are exclusively found in the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate.
- [Flying Ant](https://reswarm.org/flying-ant.html): Flying Ants are one of five mobs that is part of a family called ants that are exclusively found in the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate.
- [Army Ant](https://reswarm.org/army-ant.html): An Army Ant is one of five mobs that is part of a family called Ants that are exclusively found in the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate.
- [Giant Ant](https://reswarm.org/giant-ant.html): A Giant Ant is one of five mobs that is part of a family called ants that are exclusively found in the Ant Challenge, past the Ant Gate.
- [Cogmower](https://reswarm.org/cogmower.html): A Cogmower is a mob that exclusively appears during Robo Bear's Challenge.
- [Golden Cogmower](https://reswarm.org/golden-cogmower.html): They do not despawn until the round is over. Unlike regular Cogmowers, Golden Cogmowers will not follow the player if they go to another field, they stay in the random field they spawned in.
- [Cogturret](https://reswarm.org/cogturret.html): A Cogturret is a mob that appears during Robo Bear Challenge.
- [Mechsquito](https://reswarm.org/mechsquito.html): A Mechsquito is one of the five Mobs that spawns during Robo Bear's Challenge.
- [Mega Mechsquito](https://reswarm.org/mega-mechsquito.html): A Mega Mechsquito is a mob that appears during Robo Bear's Challenge.
- [Stick Bug](https://reswarm.org/stick-bug.html): This page is for the Stick Bug NPC. For attack behaviour and the actual challenge, please see Stick Bug Challenge
- [Stick Nymph](https://reswarm.org/stick-nymph.html): The Stick Nymph is a mob that is summoned by Stick Bug during the Stick Bug Challenge.
- [Party Cogmower](https://reswarm.org/party-cogmower.html): The Party Cogmower is one of the mobs exclusive to Robo Party. It functions similar to a Golden Cogmower, only staying at one field until the party ends.

- [Frog](https://reswarm.org/frog.html): Frogs are passive mobs added in the 2019-12-23 Update. They despawn after a set period of time (3 minutes if summoned by a Box-O-Frogs or 20 seconds (+2s per level) if summoned by a Tadpole Bee).
- [Fireflies](https://reswarm.org/fireflies.html): Fireflies are passive mobs that only appear during nighttime. Individually, they produce sparkles on the flowers that they land on. Fireflies band together to generate various items for the player.

## Beequips
- [Beequips](https://reswarm.org/browse-beequips.html): Beequips go on your bees. They are sorted by the bee level they need, lowest first.
- [Beequip](https://reswarm.org/beequip.html): This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.
- [Beequip Generation](https://reswarm.org/beequip-generation.html): This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.
- [Bandage](https://reswarm.org/bandage.html): A Bandage is a level 3 Beequip. It has an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement.
- [Elf Cap](https://reswarm.org/elf-cap.html): An Elf Cap is a level 3 Beesmas beequip. It has an equip limit of two. There is no color requirement.
- [Thimble](https://reswarm.org/thimble.html): A Thimble is a level 3 Beequip. It has an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement.
- [Beesmas Top](https://reswarm.org/beesmas-top.html): A Beesmas Top is a level 4 Beesmas beequip. It has an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement. It can only be equipped to common or rare bees.
- [Bottle Cap](https://reswarm.org/bottle-cap.html): The Bottle Cap is a level 4 Beequip. It has an equip limit of two. There is no color requirement. It can only be equipped to common or rare bees. It was released in the 2022-04-01 update.
- [Sweatband](https://reswarm.org/sweatband.html): The Sweatband is a level 5 Beequip. It has an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement.
- [Warm Scarf](https://reswarm.org/warm-scarf.html): The Warm Scarf is a level 5 Beesmas beequip. It has an equip limit of three. There is no color requirement, but can only be equipped to Basic, Rad, Exhausted, Frosty, and Shy Bees.

## Update Logs
- [Update Logs](https://reswarm.org/update-logs.html): Every Re://:Swarm update, newest first, from the game's Discord changelog.
- [Oct 3, 2026: Bee levels, sticker inventory and fixes](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-10-03.html): A display change for bee levels and a few fixes.
- [Oct 2, 2026: Painter Bee update](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-10-02.html): The Painter Bee Event: a new bee, new flowers, a new wax and a new Puffshroom tier.
- [Painter Bee Event](https://reswarm.org/painter-bee-event.html): The Painter Bee event is a Re://:Swarm update built around the new Painter Bee. During the event the game is titled [PAINTER BEE] Re://:Swarm.
- [Painter Bee](https://reswarm.org/painter-bee.html): Painter Bee is a Colorless Event bee added in the Painter Bee event. Its body is grey, and the Gifted version is light blue.
- [Painter Stickers](https://reswarm.org/painter-stickers.html): The Painter stickers are a set of stickers added in the Painter Bee event.
- [Fluxite Wax](https://reswarm.org/fluxite-wax.html): "Rerolls a Beequip's potential: 1 pot (38%), 2 pot (30%), 3 pot (20%), 4 pot (9%), or 5 pot (3%). Doesn't use a Wax slot."
- [Sep 29, 2026: SSA locking on mobile](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-29.html)
- [Sep 27, 2026: Quest fix](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-27.html)
- [Sep 26, 2026: Equipment models and amulets](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-26.html): New models for all equipment, Rebirth 39, and amulet rerolls with stat locking.
- [Sep 22, 2026: Hive Hub](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-22.html)
- [Sep 21, 2026: Honeycomb Blueprint upgrades](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-21.html): The Honeycomb Blueprint gets leveling, mutation rolling and hive slot buying.
- [Sep 18, 2026: Mortar Bee update](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-18.html): A new Mythic bee, new bag models, the Honeycomb Blueprint and many fixes.
- [Sep 15, 2026: Camera zoom](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-15.html)
- [Sep 14, 2026: Puffshroom changes](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-14.html)
- [Sep 13, 2026: Tool models](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-13.html): New models for every tool and a new code.
- [Sep 12, 2026: Better start](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-12.html)
- [Sep 11, 2026: Rebirth 35 and Melittology paths](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-11.html): Rebirth 35, three new Melittology paths and five new stickers.
- [Sep 4, 2026: Early rebirth nerfs](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-04.html): Two nerfs to stop players almost instantly skipping early rebirths.
- [Sep 3, 2026: Crafting and planters](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-03.html): Craftable Marshmallow Bee and Debug Wax, faster converters and glitter buffs.
- [Sep 1, 2026: Quality of life](https://reswarm.org/update-log-2026-09-01.html): Auto sprinklers, auto gifted basic eggs, quest chaining and balance changes.

## Codes
- [Codes](https://reswarm.org/codes.html): Codes give free rewards like Tickets, Honey, stickers and buffs.

## Rebirths
- [Rebirths](https://reswarm.org/rebirths.html): Rebirths are Re://:Swarm's main progression system. Rebirthing spends nothing but your current honey: it sets it back to 0 and in return gives you big permanent multipliers and a set of item...

## Melittology
- [Melittology](https://reswarm.org/melittology.html): Melittology is Re://:Swarm's research tree. It unlocks at Rebirth 10 and lets you spend Research Points on permanent upgrades, ending with the Honey Hammer and upgrades for The Supreme Saturator.
- [Melittology Research](https://reswarm.org/melittology-research.html): Melittology Research is the questline that earns you Research Points for the Melittology tree. It has 25 ranks, from the Melittology Quests pad on the mountain top.
- [Melittology Machine](https://reswarm.org/melittology-machine.html): The Melittology Machine opens the Melittology tree. It's on the yellow ledge on the mountain top, near the Boost Market and Onett's Lid Art, right next to the Melittology Quests pad.
- [Melittology Quests](https://reswarm.org/melittology-quest-giver.html): The Melittology Quests pad gives out the Melittology Research quests, which earn Research Points for the Melittology tree. It's a blue and white pad on the yellow ledge on the mountain top, right...

## Mechanics
- [Mechanics](https://reswarm.org/browse-mechanics.html)
- [Ability Tokens](https://reswarm.org/ability-tokens.html): Ability tokens are tokens generated by bees, which can be collected to activate special abilities and buffs. Almost all bees spawn ability tokens, with the exceptions being ungifted Basic Bee and...
- [Amulet](https://reswarm.org/amulet.html): This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.
- [Badges](https://reswarm.org/badges.html): Badges are part of the achievement system of Re://:Swarm. There are currently 155 badges in Re://:Swarm (including inactive badges). 30 of the badges are currently unobtainable.
- [Balloon](https://reswarm.org/balloon.html): Balloons are items that hold pollen for players and bring it back to the hive to convert into honey later. There are 6 types of balloons: pink, red, white, black, blue and gold. Pink, red, white,...
- [Battle Points](https://reswarm.org/battle-points.html): Battle Points are points used for Global Top Battlers Leaderboard rankings and the Battle Badge. They are obtained by defeating certain mobs.
- [Bee Attack](https://reswarm.org/bee-attack.html): Bee Attack is a mechanic that causes bees to attack mobs in a radius. When attacking, bees will deploy a small red laser (presumably a stinger) to deal damage based on the amount of bee attack...
- [Beequip Generation](https://reswarm.org/beequip-generation.html): This piece of content contains information obtained through datamining.
- [Blender](https://reswarm.org/blender.html): The Blender is a machine located in the Badge Bearer's Guild. The machine's usage is to create consumable items from pre-existing items. However, the player is only able to craft one type of item...
- [Bond](https://reswarm.org/bond.html): Bond can be checked at any time by clicking on the bee's hive slot and it will show the bee's bond and stats.
- [Bubble](https://reswarm.org/bubble.html): Bubbles are objects that can be produced by certain tools, abilities, or passive abilities. Bubbles have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering. Bubbles spawn on the...
- [Buffs & Debuffs](https://reswarm.org/buffs-debuffs.html): Buffs and Debuffs are one of the core gameplay mechanics. The player can obtain them from amulets, quest givers, items, ability tokens, codes, and different dispensers. Some buffs and debuffs are...
- [Capacity](https://reswarm.org/capacity.html): Capacity is a mechanic that shows how much pollen the player can store at a time. Capacity can be increased in a variety of ways including buffs, items, stickers, and amulets. Capacity can be...
- [Cloud](https://reswarm.org/cloud.html): Clouds are small, white rain clouds that can be summoned through various methods (listed below). They move around the field aimlessly over a 1-5 minute time span, depending on the source of the...
- [Critical Hits](https://reswarm.org/critical-hits.html): This piece of content recently got an update.
- [Cub Buddy](https://reswarm.org/cub-buddy.html): A Cub Buddy is a small, baby version of a bear that follows the player around, collects tokens, and creates gifts. Whenever the player's cub buddy gets too far away, it will teleport back to them.
- [Day/Night Cycle](https://reswarm.org/day-night-cycle.html): The Day/Night Cycle is a feature added in the 2018-09-10 update. Before the update, it was always daytime.
- [Emoticons](https://reswarm.org/emoticons.html): Emoticons are a mechanic for showing a bee's mood. The mood can affect how much bond a bee gets when it collects pollen[1], bee movespeed[1], and can even enable some bees to find certain stickers...
- [Energy](https://reswarm.org/energy.html): Energy represents the number of times a bee will gather pollen from a flower, sip nectar, and attack mobs before returning to the hive to rest. Each action costs one energy. Spawning Ability...
- [Field Boost](https://reswarm.org/field-boost.html): A Field Boost is a stacking buff that provides a bonus to pollen gained, from all sources, from a specific field. Each stack of a field boost increases pollen gained from its field by 100% and has...
- [Field Capacity](https://reswarm.org/field-capacity.html): Field Capacity is a mechanic that increases the player's Capacity Multiplier depending on what kind of field they are in. There are 2 types of field capacity: colored field capacity (shown as a...
- [Field Wind](https://reswarm.org/field-wind.html): A Field Wind is a stacking buff that grants a bonus to pollen and instant conversion to a specific field. Each stack of a field wind increases pollen gained from its field by a set amount...
- [Flame](https://reswarm.org/flame.html): Flames are objects that can be produced by certain tools, ability tokens, or passive abilities. Flames have a percentage chance to be spawned by certain bees when gathering, lasting for 4 seconds....
- [Flowers](https://reswarm.org/flowers.html): Flowers can be found in all fields. They can be interacted with using different sources to obtain pollen from and later be converted into honey. There are 5 flower sizes: single, double, triple,...

## About the game
- [About the game](https://reswarm.org/browse-about-the-game.html)
- [Easter Eggs](https://reswarm.org/easter-eggs.html): Throughout the map, plenty of Easter Eggs can be found. Some of them have been removed, while some still exist.
- [FAQ](https://reswarm.org/faq.html): As with practically anything, some questions come up over and over as more people discover the game.
- [Medals](https://reswarm.org/medals.html): We found out that our achievement system can be abused. Some people farm edits just to get badges, and we are not happy.

- [Tutorial](https://reswarm.org/tutorial.html): The Tutorial in Re://:Swarm is a guided walkthrough led by Black Bear. Instead of flipping through picture pages, new players get one objective at a time in Black Bear's dialogue panel, and each...
